subject: Geography
chapter: The Origin and Evolution of the Earth
central_question: How did the universe, stars, planets and the earth develop into a layered planet with an atmosphere, oceans and life?
in_scope_units: Early theories of earth and planet formation.
The Big Bang Theory and expansion of the universe.
Formation of galaxies and stars and the meaning of light year.
Planet formation through planetesimals and accretion.
Evolution and differentiation of the lithosphere.
Evolution of atmosphere, hydrosphere and life.
banned_topics: Detailed seismic-wave evidence, which belongs to Interior of the Earth.
Plate tectonics, which belongs to Distribution of Oceans and Continents.
Detailed atmospheric structure, which belongs to a later atmosphere chapter.

known_pitfalls.claim: A light year is a unit of time.
known_pitfalls.correction: It is the distance light travels in one year.

known_pitfalls.claim: The balloon model proves galaxies themselves expand.
known_pitfalls.correction: It only illustrates increasing space between galaxies.

known_pitfalls.claim: Planets formed directly as full-sized bodies.
known_pitfalls.correction: They developed through condensation, planetesimals, collision and accretion.

known_pitfalls.claim: The first atmosphere was like today’s.
known_pitfalls.correction: The primordial atmosphere was lost and a later one evolved through degassing and life.
The chapter states that early life evolved in oceans.

recommended_example_progression: Use Exercise 2(ii–iii) to describe the early earth and atmosphere.
Use Exercise 3(i) to explain the Big Bang Theory.
Use Exercise 3(ii) to organise stages in earth’s evolution.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The chapter ends with Exercises 1(i–iii), 2(i–iii), 3(i–ii), and a three-part Stardust Project Work.
